title: Native SFTP Support in Business Central 28
summary: Native SFTP support was briefly introduced in Business Central 28 via a new SFTP Client codeunit, enabling asynchronous file operations with external servers. However, Microsoft removed this feature due to security hardening concerns, requiring users to use Azure Functions as an alternative for SFTP connectivity.
key_points: SFTP Client codeunit (ID 9762) provided native SFTP operations: list files, upload, download, and delete
Feature was removed after initial release due to platform hardening requirements and scope concerns
Sensitive FTP credentials should be stored using Isolated Storage with SecretText for passwords
SFTP connections require server fingerprint validation using SHA256 before initializing the client

quotes.text: The FTP system only supports 4 commands. List Files, Upload File, Download File, and Delete File.
quotes.why_it_matters: Defines the complete scope of SFTP operations available before removal, helping developers understand feature limitations
